description: Registry of reviewed and accepted dependency advisories with documented rationale and review dates. These advisories are actively monitored by Mission Control and do not trigger false-positive ACTION_REQUIRED production incidents unless their scope expands.

nodemailer.reason: Direct dependency required by next-auth EmailProvider. Removing nodemailer while EmailProvider is imported causes clean Vercel/Turbopack production build failures. The package is not exposed to untrusted external input in the current CMS mailer architecture.

@auth/core.reason: Upstream NextAuth v4 peer dependency. Core authentication flow is strictly isolated behind NextAuth session middleware. Upstream fix is tracked for NextAuth v5 upgrade.

@auth/drizzle-adapter.reason: Adapter dependency tied to NextAuth v4 ecosystem. All database queries pass through Drizzle ORM schema validation.

next-auth.reason: NextAuth v4 framework dependency. Production configuration uses secure session tokens and server-side secret validation. Monitored until major framework upgrade.
